messages.subject: Neighborhood  definition( adjacency matrix)
parts:
Am new to INLA, 
I want to implement a model that instead of using polygons (sharing borders) to define an adjacency matrix, I use points within a certain cutoff distance to define this adjacency matrix. 

How can I do this?

messages.author: 66ed4f72a898a51c
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Neighborhood definition( adjacency matrix)
parts:
Hi,

Code example to define adjacency as points within a certain cutoff:

n <- 30
xy <- cbind(runif(n), runif(n))
cutoff <- 0.1
j <- lapply(1:n, function(i)
setdiff(which(sqrt((xy[,1]-xy[i,1])^2 +
(xy[,2]-xy[i,2])^2)<cutoff),i))
nn <- sapply(j,length)
graph <- sparseMatrix(i=rep(1:n, nn), j=unlist(j),
x=rep(1, sum(nn)), dims=c(n,n))
image(graph)

The 'graph' object can be supplied in Besag's like models as
f(..., graph=graph)

best,
Elias
